    ClientConnection

    ClientConnectionUser
    Callback contract implemented by whoever consumes client connections (the ServerController).
    ClientController
    Main controller class on the client side.
    ClientInfo

    ClientMain
    Main entry point for launching the game client application.
    ClientModel
    The ClientModel class represents the local client-side state of the game.
    ClientPlayer
    Represents the client-side local state of a player in the game.
    ClientRMI
    Thin RMI wrapper that would expose a ServerRMIConnection as a remote client stub by delegating ClientRMI.sendMessage(Message).
    ClientRMIConnection
    Server-side "brain" representing a single connected client over RMI.
    ClientsConnectionManager
    Central registry of all connected clients on the server, keyed by player UUID.
    ClientState
    Represents the distinct phases or connection statuses of a client during their lifecycle on the server.
    Color
    Colors that can be assigned to players.
    Command
    A client-to-server message that carries an action to perform, as opposed to a mere Ping.
    CommandReceiver
    Sink for commands arriving from clients, implemented by the ServerController.
    ConnectionFactory
    Builds server-side client connections, injecting into each one the shared command receiver (the ServerController) and the connection manager.
    ConnectionHandler
    Contract used by a server-side connection to register or unregister itself in the connection manager.
    ConnectionScene
    Scene controller for managing the initial server connection screen.
    CustomScene
    Abstract base class for all GUI scene controllers.
    DatabaseConfig
    Holds the connection parameters (URL, user, password) used to access the database.
    DatabaseManager
    Acts as a central utility provider for database connections.
    DataClientToServer
    Root of everything that travels from a client to the server.
    DataServerToClient
    Root of everything that travels from the server to a client.
    DisconnectedException
    Thrown to indicate that the client has been disconnected and activate alternative input parsing.
    Error
    A server-to-client message reporting that something went wrong.
    Error.GenericServerError
    A generic, uncategorized server-side failure.
    Error.IllegalMoveError
    A requested move was not legal in the current game state.
    Error.InvalidPlayerError
    The player identity was not valid when joining a lobby.
    Error.LobbyCreationError
    Creating a lobby failed; shown on the lobby-choice screen.
    Error.LobbyJoinError
    Joining a lobby failed; shown on the lobby-choice screen.
    Error.OutOfTurnError
    The player tried to act when it was not their turn.
    Error.WrongPhaseError
    The action is not allowed in the current game phase.
    Event
    Base class for every event card.
    EventBuilding
    Base class for buildings that react to events.
    EventEffect<T>
    Strategy describing how an event building reacts to a given event type.
    EventEffect.BonusHuntEvent
    Effect that grants prestige points and food equal to the player's number of hunters.
    EventEffect.BonusPaintingEvent
    Effect that grants food equal to the player's number of artists.
    EventEffect.DoubleWinInRitualEvent
    Effect that doubles the ritual reward (era × 5 prestige points) for a winning player.
    EventEffect.NoLossInRitualEvent
    Effect that cancels the ritual malus for a losing player.
    Executor<T>
    A thread-safe, single-threaded task executor that sequentially processes tasks asynchronously against a specific target object.
    FinalBuilding
    A building whose effect is applied once, at the end of the game, according to the FinalEffect strategy it carries.
    FinalEffect
    Strategy describing the end-game scoring effect of a FinalBuilding.
    FinalEffect.FinalBonusPrestigePoints
    Grants a flat bonus of 25 prestige points.
    FinalEffect.FinalDoubleBuilderPrestigePoints
    Grants prestige points equal to the total prestige points of the player's builders.
    FinalEffect.FinalPrestigePointsByCharacterType
    Grants prestige points proportional to how many characters of a given type the player owns.
    FinalEffect.FinalPrestigePointsPerSet
    Grants 6 prestige points for each complete set of characters the player owns.
    Game
    Core model class representing the state and game logic of a single match.
    GameCommand
    Base class for in-game commands, i.e. actions targeting a running game.
    GameCommand.ConnectionCommand
    Internal: signals that a player has (re)connected to the game.
    GameCommand.DisconnectionCommand
    Internal: signals that a player has disconnected from the game.
    GameCommand.EndGameCommand
    Internal: signals that the game has ended and the lobby must be closed.
    GameCommand.EndTurnCommand
    Wire command: the player ends their turn.
    GameCommand.JoinLobbyCommand
    Wire command: the player asks to join the lobby.
    GameCommand.PickCardCommand
    Wire command: the player picks the card identified by cardId.
    GameCommand.PickNameColorCommand
    Wire command: the player picks their nickname and color to join the game.
    GameCommand.PlaceTotemCommand
    Wire command: the player places a totem at the given board position.
    GameCommand.RecoveryTimeoutCommand
    Internal: signals that the disconnected-player recovery window expired.
    GameCommand.RejoinLobbyCommand
    Wire command: the player asks to rejoin the lobby after a disconnection.
    GameCommand.SinglePlayerTimeoutCommand
    Internal: signals the single-player turn timer expired.
    GameCommandReceiver
    Sink for in-game commands only, implemented by whoever dispatches GameCommands to a specific game (the GameController).
    GameController
    Controller managing a single game instance on the server.
    GameEndedException
    Thrown when a player attempts an action on a concluded game
    GameLoader
    Loads the game configuration from the bundled config.json resource and builds the decks, the offer track and the board parameters.
    GameObserver
    Interface defining the observer pattern used by the game controller to monitoring state changes within the game model.
    GamePhase
    The phases of the game state machine.
    GameRecovery
    A serializable data transfer object (DTO) that captures a snapshot of a game's state.
    GameStartedException
    Thrown to indicate that the game has started and activate updated input parsing.
    Gatherer
    Character card that increases the player's sustenance discount during sustenance events when added to a tribe.
    GUI
    Main Graphical User Interface orchestrator.
    GuiApplication

    GuiNavigator

    HeartBeat

    HuntEvent

    IllegalPlayerInitializationException

    OrderQueueSlot.State

    OrderQueueSlotBuilder

    OutOfTurnException
    Thrown when a player attempts to act outside of their turn.
    PaintingEvent
    Painting event: rewards players whose number of artists reaches the era threshold and penalizes those who fall short.
    PaintingEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a PaintingEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    PersistencyManager
    Manages disk serialization and recovery routines for server resilience.
    PersistentClientConnection
    Server-side view of a client connection that is long-lived and liveness-aware.
    PersistentServerConnection
    Client-side view of the connection to the server that is long-lived and liveness-aware.
    Ping
    Keep-alive probe sent from the client to the server.
    Player
    Represents a participant in the match, tracking individual resources such as food and prestige points, persistent bonuses, and offer-related actions.
    PlayerStatus
    The possible connection/participation states of a player during a game.
    PlayerTribeNode
    JavaFX node that displays the cards in a player's tribe grouped by metadata type.
    PointsPair
    Utility data class representing clearly labeled player resources.
    Pong
    Keep-alive acknowledgement sent from the server to the client in reply to a ping.
    PopUp
    A temporary notification overlay anchored to a parent JavaFX stage.
    RankElement
    Represents a single entry in the leaderboard list.
    RankingDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) for managing match results and leaderboard entries.
    Reaper
    Server-side liveness watchdog.
    ResiliencyManager
    Manages client side recovery of local identity stored configurations.
    RitualEvent
    Ritual event: the players with the fewest shaman stars suffer a malus, while those with the most gain extra prestige points.
    RitualEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a RitualEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    Row
    A single row of the board (top or bottom).
    ServerAccessRMI
    RMI entry point on the server side (the "doorman"), published in the registry.
    ServerCommand
    Base class for pre-game / lobby commands, i.e. actions handled directly by the ServerController rather than by a specific game.
    ServerCommand.ConnectionCommand
    Internal: signals that a player has (re)connected at the server level.
    ServerCommand.CreateLobbyCommand
    Wire command: the client creates a new lobby with nickname, color and size.
    ServerCommand.DisconnectionCommand
    Internal: signals that a player has disconnected at the server level.
    ServerCommand.FetchLobbiesCommand
    Wire command: the client asks for the list of available lobbies.
    ServerCommand.NotifyEndGameCommand
    Internal: notifies the server that the game in the given lobby has ended.
    ServerCommand.PickLobbyCommand
    Wire command: the client joins the lobby identified by lobbyId.
    ServerCommand.PutPlayerChoosingCommand
    Internal: moves a player into the "choosing" state.
    ServerCommand.RejoinGameCommand
    Wire command: the client answers whether to rejoin a previously left game.
    ServerConnection
    Minimal client-side view of the connection to the server: it can send commands and be opened/closed.
    ServerConnectionUser
    Callback contract implemented on the client side (by the ClientController).
    ServerController
    Global server-side controller.
    ServerMain
    Main initialization entry point for the game server application.
    ServerRMIConnection
    Client-side "brain" representing the connection to the server over RMI.
    ServerScheduler
    Utility class providing a centralized, shared thread pool for managing scheduled actions on the server.
    Shaman
    Character card that contributes shaman stars when added to a player's tribe.
    SocketClientConnection
    Server-side "brain" representing a single connected client over a socket: it holds everything the server needs to talk to that client, namely the socket, the SocketClientListener (the "ear" that reads incoming data) and the SocketClientHandler (the "mouth" that writes outgoing data).
    SocketClientHandler
    Server-side "mouth" of a client connection: serializes outgoing objects to JSON and writes them, one line at a time, onto the client's socket.
    SocketClientListener
    Server-side "ear" of a client connection: a dedicated thread that blocks on readLine(), deserializes each incoming JSON line into a DataClientToServer and routes it back to the owning connection (a ping refreshes liveness, a command is forwarded).
    SocketServerAccess
    Socket entry point on the server side: the "doorman".
    SocketServerConnection
    Client-side "brain" representing the connection to the server over a socket.
    SocketServerHandler
    Client-side "mouth" of the server connection: serializes outgoing commands (and pings) to JSON and writes them, one line at a time, onto the server's socket.
    SocketServerListener
    Client-side "ear" of the server connection: a dedicated thread that blocks on readLine(), deserializes each incoming JSON line into a DataServerToClient and routes it to the owning connection (a pong refreshes liveness, an update or error is forwarded).
    SustenanceEvent
    Sustenance event: each player must spend food equal to their tribe size (less any discount); players who cannot pay lose prestige points instead.
    SustenanceEventBuilding
    Event building that reacts to a SustenanceEvent according to the EventEffect it carries.
    Task<T>
    Represents a command or action designed to be executed on a given target object type.
    TextFormatting
    Utility class defining ANSI escape codes for TUI text formatting and coloring.
    TimedBuilding
    A building whose effect is triggered at specific moments of a round, according to the TimedEffect strategy it carries.
    TimedEffect
    Strategy describing the round-time effect of a TimedBuilding.
    TimedEffect.BonusPickCard
    Grants an additional draw action from the top row at the end of a round when the order queue is full.
    TimedEffect.BonusTurnFood
    Grants one extra food during action resolution when the current player acts while a food bonus is available and the order queue is not full.
    TotemNode
    JavaFX node that renders a colored player totem.
    Tribe
    Represents a player's collection of cards, split based on card type.
    TribeBonus
    Strategy describing the recurring bonus granted by a TribeBuilding.
    TribeBonus.BonusShamanStars
    Grants 3 shaman stars, but only from the second time it is evaluated onwards.
    TribeBonus.FoodOnInventorSymbolPair
    Grants food equal to 3 times the number of inventor symbol pairs.
    TribeBonus.FoodOnSet
    Grants food equal to 5 times the number of complete character sets.
    TribeBonus.SustenanceDiscountByCharacterType
    Grants a sustenance discount based on the number of a given character type.
    TribeBuilding
    A building that grants a recurring TribeBonus.
    TribeCard
    Base class for the cards a player can pick into their tribe (characters and buildings).
    TribeDeck
    The deck of tribe cards (characters and events) drawn during the game.
    TribeDeckCardDTO
    Data Transfer Object for tribe deck cards (characters and events) as stored in the configuration file.

    TribeDeckCardDTO.BuilderDTO
    DTO that creates a Builder.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.GathererDTO
    DTO that creates a Gatherer.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.HuntDTO
    DTO that creates a HuntEvent.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.HunterDTO
    DTO that creates a Hunter.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.InventorDTO
    DTO that creates an Inventor.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.PaintDTO
    DTO that creates a PaintingEvent.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.RitualDTO
    DTO that creates a RitualEvent.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.ShamanDTO
    DTO that creates a Shaman.
    TribeDeckCardDTO.SustenanceDTO
    DTO that creates a SustenanceEvent.
    TUI
    Main Text-based User Interface orchestrator.
    UI
    The generalized View interface for the client-side application.
    Update
    A server-to-client message describing a state change the client must apply to its local model.
    Update.AvailableLobbiesUpdate
    Refreshes the list of joinable lobbies shown to the client.
    Update.BuildingBoughtUpdate
    Reflects that a player bought a building at a given cost.
    Update.BuildingEffectUpdate
    Applies a building effect (resource bonus) for a player.
    Update.CardPickedUpdate
    Reflects that a player picked a card (possibly the final pick of the turn).
    Update.CurrentPlayerUpdate
    Sets which player is currently to move.
    Update.FoodOfferUpdate
    Resolves a player's food offer.
    Update.GameJoinedUpdate
    Sets the client's own player after joining a game.
    Update.GameOverUpdate
    Ends the game, providing winners and final points.
    Update.GameRestartedUpdate
    Rebuilds the full game state on the client after a restart/recovery.
    Update.GameStartedUpdate
    Bootstraps the client model with the full initial game state.
    Update.HunterEffectUpdate
    Applies a hunter effect (food gain) for a player.
    Update.HuntEventEffectUpdate
    Applies the per-player effects of a hunt event.
    Update.LeaderboardUpdate
    Shows the global leaderboard and the players' ranks.
    Update.LobbyCreatedUpdate
    Confirms the lobby was created and sets the client's own player and lobby.
    Update.LobbyJoinedUpdate
    Confirms the client joined a lobby and provides its current players.
    Update.NewLobbyJoinUpdate
    Updates the current player count of the client's own lobby.
    Update.NewLobbyUpdate
    Adds a newly created lobby to the client's list of lobbies.
    Update.NewPhaseUpdate
    Advances the client model to a new game phase.
    Update.NewRoundUpdate
    Ends the current round and deals the new era's card rows.
    Update.OrderModifierUpdate
    Applies a turn-order / prestige modifier for a player.
    Update.PaintingEventEffectUpdate
    Applies the per-player effects of a painting event.
    Update.PlayerAddedUpdate
    Adds another player (nickname and color) to the client's view.
    Update.PlayerDisconnectedUpdate
    Reflects that a player has disconnected from the game.
    Update.PlayerReconnectionUpdate
    Reflects that a previously disconnected player has reconnected.
    Update.RejoinRequestUpdate
    Asks the client to restore a previous player identity for a rejoin.
    Update.RitualEventEffectUpdate
    Applies the per-player effects of a ritual event.
    Update.SustenaceEventEffectUpdate
    Applies the per-player effects of a sustenance event.
    Update.TimerStartedUpdate
    Starts the single-player turn timer on the client.
    Update.TotemPlacedUpdate
    Reflects that a player placed a totem at a given board position.
    Update.TurnEndedUpdate
    Reflects that a player ended their turn.
    UtilsJSON
    Utility class providing a globally shared Jackson object mapper instance for JSON serialization and deserialization processing.
    ViewState
    Represents the client state based on the currently active view.
    VirtualClient
    Protocol-agnostic contract for everything that can act as a client endpoint, i.e. an object the server is able to push a Message to.
    VirtualClientRmi
    RMI-specific marker interface for a client endpoint.
    VirtualClientSocket
    Socket-specific specialization of VirtualClient.
    VirtualServer
    Protocol-agnostic contract for everything that can act as a server endpoint, i.e. an object a client is able to send a command to.
    VirtualServerAccessRMI
    Remote access point published in the RMI registry: the RMI counterpart of the socket doorman.
    VirtualServerRMI
    RMI-specific specialization of VirtualServer, used as the type of the server connection's stub.
    VirtualServerSocket
    Socket-specific specialization of VirtualServer.
